prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: world overview concept illustration for "Riwaq — Neighborhood of Stories", an original Arabic 2D mobile educational adventure for children aged 6–12.
Primary request: Illustrate the canonical village hub and its five nearby exploration destinations in ONE coherent wide landscape environment map. This is visual world concept art, no gameplay UI.
Scene/backdrop: A small welcoming village in a shallow green valley. Round central Seed Square with a broad tree, low benches and planted pots. Surrounding it are Nawwar's small apricot clay home, Rukn's sandy-clay workshop with timber, Wariq's sage-leaf-roof library, a shared courtyard kitchen under a cream cloth canopy, a quiet modest prayer-place pavilion, and a short neighboring-doorway lane. Clear rounded-stone footpaths and low arched wooden gates connect them.
World geography: A visibly continuous loop leaves the hub over a wide wooden reed bridge crossing a shallow turquoise channel, proceeds to a low fruit-tree grove with large fruit and baskets, then a clear spring with low edging and a small hand fountain, then a gentle hill with shade canopies and a fenced walking path, then a large meadow garden with a circular meeting space, and reconnects to the village. These are five walkable destinations in one small valley, not disconnected floating islands.
Style/medium: HAND-PAINTED 2D gouache and layered cut-paper children's adventure illustration; simple warm internal shading, gentle paper grain, rounded readable structures, original tactile architecture, no 3D render. Elevated three-quarter map perspective with flat illustrated depth.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape map, central village prominent in the foreground/midground, winding connected route and small destination vignettes in the surrounding valley. Large readable shapes, natural useful spaces, thoughtful paths. NO characters in this environment overview so location layout remains readable.
Lighting/mood: Bright warm morning after light rain, fresh greenery, welcoming explorer mood.
Color palette: Apricot #F2AD64, sandstone #C7A77D, sage #8FA987, turquoise #79B6B0, cream #F7E7C7, dark cocoa accents #3B3030. Small coral accents only.
Constraints: Opaque painted scenic background. No text, no labels, no lettering on signboards, no logos, no watermark, no human figures, no supernatural imagery, no magical portals, no sacred calligraphy, no UI. No musical instruments. Paths must visibly connect the village and all five destinations. This is concept art, not a production tilemap.
